issues.title: CLI: `nimbus sync` exits 0 when the daemon is unreachable
issues.description: A cron job calling `nimbus sync` reports success while syncing nothing. Connection failure must exit non-zero and say which socket it tried.

comments.body: Exit code 7 + the socket path in the error. Also added `--wait` for boot-order races under systemd.

issues.title: Daemon leaks one file descriptor per reconnect
issues.description: Soak test: 10k reconnects, 10k fds. The old watch handle is dropped without close() when the config reload path re-creates the watcher.

issues.title: Config reload drops in-flight transfers
issues.description: SIGHUP tears down the transfer pool before draining it. Reload should be graceful: stop accepting, drain with a deadline, then swap config.

issues.title: Man page and shell completions out of date for the new flags
issues.description: `--wait`, `--json` and `--profile` exist in `--help` but not in the man page or completions. Generate all three from the same flag table so this can't drift again.

issues.title: Windows service wrapper: clean shutdown loses the journal tail
issues.description: Service stop gives the daemon 5 s; a busy journal flush needs up to 20. Ask for the extended stop window and fsync the tail before ack'ing stop.

issues.title: `nimbus status --json` emits duration as localized string
issues.description: "1,5 s" on a German locale breaks every parser. JSON output must be locale-independent: seconds as a number.

comments.body: Numbers everywhere in --json now; human formatting only in the table view. Contract test pins the schema.

issues.title: Retry storm when the remote rejects the protocol version
issues.description: A permanent error (unsupported protocol) is retried like a transient one — every 2 s, forever, logging 40 GB/week across the fleet. Classify permanent errors and stop.

issues.title: First-run wizard writes config with 0644 despite containing the token
issues.description: The auth token lands world-readable. Write 0600 from the start and warn-and-fix on load when permissions are looser.
